title: AGENTS.md: API constraint rules
description: Add generation-time rules to AGENTS.md: (1) no String/&str for a spec-closed vocabulary in pub types: use impl_string_enum!; (2) no in-band sentinel values (e.g. "placeholder"); (3) a pub fn or trait method needing more than ~4 non-self arguments takes a params struct (non_exhaustive where growable); (4) no trait default that puts wrong data on the wire (existing spec-method-defaults policy); (5) growable pub enums/structs are #[non_exhaustive] except builder-style *Input/*Patch; (6) one public path per item. Note that the Canonical Templates rule copies flaws too: fix the canonical, then mirror.
